description: Important cash crop grown widely in East Africa.

diseases.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
diseases.description: Fungal disease causing orange powdery spots on leaves.
diseases.organic_treatment: Remove infected leaves and improve air circulation.
diseases.prevention_tips: Use resistant varieties and prune regularly.

diseases.name: Coffee Berry Disease
diseases.chemical_treatment: Apply approved fungicides during flowering and fruit development.
diseases.prevention_tips: Maintain field sanitation and proper pruning.

diseases.name: Coffee Wilt Disease
diseases.description: Serious disease causing sudden wilting and plant death.
